description: This file defines the SourceMapGenerator class used for generating source maps in a PHP project, including methods for adding mappings, generating JSON output, and handling filename normalization.

classes.name: SourceMapGenerator
classes.description: A class for creating and managing source maps, including adding mappings, generating JSON output, and filename normalization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SourceMapGenerator with optional configuration options and sets up the base64 VLQ encoder.

methods.name: addMapping
methods.description: Adds a mapping between generated and original source positions, associating them with a source file.

methods.name: saveMap
methods.description: Saves the generated source map to a specified file; deprecated method.

methods.name: generateJson
methods.description: Generates the JSON representation of the source map, including mappings, sources, and optional source content.

methods.name: getSourcesContent
methods.description: Retrieves the content of all source files included in the source map.

methods.name: generateMappings
methods.description: Creates the encoded mappings string for the source map, optionally with a prefix.

methods.name: findFileIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of a source file in the sources list.

methods.name: normalizeFilename
methods.description: Normalizes filenames by fixing Windows paths and removing base path prefixes.

methods.name: fixWindowsPath
methods.description: Converts Windows backslash paths to forward slash paths and optionally adds a trailing slash.
